issues.title: Refund challenge produces an inconsistent cited refusal
issues.expected: Explicit cited refusal matching the original unchanged expectation
issues.observed: Original suite 21/22; three fresh repeats passed 2/3, with one generic safe abstention.
issues.impact: No false refund guarantee observed; required explanation and source evidence are inconsistent.
issues.next_step: Agree the grounded refusal behavior, fix or formally approve the expectation, then rerun original RAG and repeated challenge.

issues.title: System delivery-receipt question is routed to follow-up status
issues.impact: A general system-concept question may enter a specific action-status workflow.
issues.next_step: Distinguish a conceptual delivery-receipt question from a request for an existing draft status; rerun both groups.

issues.title: English exclusive-bathroom claim is filtered to unknown
issues.expected: The bathroom is not shared with anyone else. -> reported_match
issues.observed: Model extracted private_bathroom / yes with the exact quote; product anchor filter removed it and returned unknown.
issues.impact: A conservative false negative loses an explicit pasted-agent claim; listing facts remain unverified.
issues.next_step: Support the English bathroom/not-shared construction while retaining negation, contradiction and quote guards; rerun all 18 reply cases.

issues.title: Query proxy maps authorization errors to HTTP 502
issues.observed: Both requests returned 502; response detail identifies the correct upstream 401 or 403.
issues.impact: Ownership protection held. Client status handling and diagnostics receive the wrong error category.
issues.next_step: Preserve upstream authorization status at the public proxy boundary; rerun HTTP ownership checks.
issues.contract_note: Proposed QA HTTP contract; not a previously approved course SLA.

issues.title: Empty rerank selection is reported as rerank unavailable
issues.expected: Safe unsupported answer without degraded service flags in the strict regression profile
issues.observed: Future-law question abstained safely, but HTTP 200 reranker returned an empty chunk_ids list and triggered rerank_unavailable / rrf_fallback.
issues.impact: Strict reliability contract failed; no invented future law was returned.
issues.next_step: Define empty-selection semantics separately from timeout or provider failure; retain safe abstention and rerun knowledge cases.
issues.related_observation: One timing workflow also degraded after a separate 10-second rerank timeout; that is not the empty-selection root cause.
